boundary: Private finite-family audit, not a shipped oracle, independent search replay, full-encounter quality, population inference or proof of general superiority.

deciding_gate.scope: Numerical criteria only; owner, consumer and review gates are separate.

guidance: For the four deciding cases of this frozen nonterminal family, 64 fixed simulations reduced mean exact one-round shaped action loss enough to meet the frozen optional-guidance gate. Three deciding seed pairs and exploratory E2 became worse. This is no general guarantee, win-probability result, default change or full-encounter claim.

publication_scope.raw_report_seed_rule: Deterministic publication subset: first predeclared seed for each of the six cases, both simulation allowances. This compact publication layout was chosen after the study completed. All 144 observations remain in this file.

retained_private_harness_failures: First capture was valid but the private helper confused the recording and fresh decision producer source scopes.
After two valid captures and eight complete E1 search/reference cells, the private helper expected the comparison page to contain a singular-page state fragment.
Both private helper errors were corrected and reviewed before the deciding freeze. Original inputs, controls, thresholds and adverse results were retained. No D retry occurred.
study: Fixed search allowance and exact one-round action loss
